record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare HYPER_DRILL: Dunsparce (catalog stars 3, passive DUNSPARCE) and Dudunsparce (catalog stars 4, passive NONE). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. The DUNSPARCE passive (stack gain on ability cast) is a separate mechanism that is not covered by this record. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target TRUE damage (raw 10/20/40/50/100 by caster stars; 40 for the listed Dunsparce, 50 for Dudunsparce). The strategy also digs in the ground-hole map of the simulation's blue player at the target's cell index: if that hole is already at depth 5 the damage is doubled and the depth stays 5, otherwise the depth is increased by 1 and the damage is not doubled (the hit that raises depth 4 to 5 is not doubled). This hole step is skipped when the simulation has no blue player (then no doubling either). Before the damage, the target's protect status is removed (status.protect = false, protectCooldown = 0), so protect does not block this hit; skydiving and magicBounce still block it inside handleSpecialDamage. TRUE damage ignores def / speDef and the flat damage reductions, but AP, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, steam board effect and crit multipliers still apply, and the final amount is rounded up with a minimum of 1.

targeting.note: The hole index uses the target's own position, but the hole array is always that of simulation.bluePlayer, regardless of which team the target or the caster is on. Whether positions of both teams map to the same index space was not examined.

geometry.shape: single target; the ground-hole map is indexed y x 8 + x

declaredRaw.label: requested damage (raw), before the hole doubling

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] x (2 if the target's cell hole was already at depth 5, else 1). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 once if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (effect consumed); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT on either side; x critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT); for TRUE damage neither Rocky Helmet crit negation nor the Black Augurite reduction applies.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers. PokemonState.handleDamage then does NOT divide by def / speDef for TRUE and skips the flat reductions (Poke Doll, Guts / Sturdy / Defiant / Coaching, Wonder Guard); it rounds up with a minimum of 1; the shield absorbs first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with skydiving / magicBounce (protect has been removed by this strategy before the call). This ability does not use the returned takenDamage or death.

effects.target: the target's cell in the blue player's groundHoles array
effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: the array is a per-player uint8 map of BOARD_WIDTH x BOARD_HEIGHT entries starting at 0, so a fresh cell needs five casts to reach depth 5 and the sixth is the first doubled one (from this ability alone; other writers exist, see unresolved). Skipped entirely without a blue player. The hole persistence between fights and rounds, and other writers (Ear Dig, passives, synergies), were not traced for this record.

declaredRaw.description: status.protect = false; status.protectCooldown = 0 (only if protect was set)

effects.resolution: runs after the hole step and before the damage; therefore the protect check at the top of handleSpecialDamage sees protect false and the hit lands. It does not touch skydiving or magicBounce.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars (table of five values; ?? 100 fallback). The listed units are catalog stars 3 and 4, so 40 and 50; 10 / 20 / 100 are not reachable by their bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The hole depth is per board cell of the target: attacking a target standing on a cell whose hole is at depth 5 doubles the hit; a different cell has its own depth. A target that moves between casts changes cell.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: State is stored in the blue player's groundHoles (outside the entity). Repeated casts on the same cell raise the depth by 1 per cast up to 5; once at 5 every further cast on that cell is doubled. Each cast spends maxPP of PP in the base process.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: TRUE damage 40 (Dunsparce) / 50 (Dudunsparce), x2 on a depth-5 hole. Applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional DOUBLE_DAMAGE / steam / crit multipliers, with no def / speDef division and no flat reductions, rounded up with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage; skydiving / magicBounce give 0. Protect is removed before the call, so it does not give 0.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, Cover Band, death handling) were not read for this record
unresolved: Passive DUNSPARCE (OnAbilityCastEffect adding stacks to the Dunsparce family) is a separate mechanism not traced here; Dudunsparce declares passive NONE
Other writers of groundHoles (Ear Dig, passives.ts, synergies.ts) and the persistence of the hole map across rounds were not traced; the depth a fight starts with is unknown from this record
Whether simulation.bluePlayer is defined for every simulation type (PVE, ghost, bot teams) was not examined; when it is undefined the strategy neither digs nor doubles
Whether blue-team and red-team targets share one index space for the blue player's hole map (the strategy always uses the blue player's array) was not examined
Whether the listed units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
